name: listQualifiedToArray
description: Converts a list to an array, treating delimiters inside qualifiers (double quotes by default) as part of the element.

params.name: qualifier
params.description: The character around elements that may contain delimiters. `qualifiers` is an alias.

params.name: qualifierRequired
params.description: When true, every element must be wrapped in the qualifier.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: When true, empty elements are included.
